summary: Iteration 3 retest through the public URL (desktop 1920 and mobile 390). Both earlier CRITICAL issues are FIXED. (1) LOGOUT works: login sets one httpOnly+Secure 'juj_session' cookie. Logout deletes it, the Login button shows again, /orders and /admin redirect to /auth?redirect=..., and a reload keeps the user logged out. (2) i18n works: all 7 dictionaries have 333 keys and content_translations has 41 offers + 9 categories x 7 locales. fr/ar/ko/es/ru all translate the UI (nav, search placeholder, Buy now, BuyBox labels, 'Not set up', footer). Category names and offer descriptions are translated, ar sets dir=rtl with a mirrored layout, and the chosen locale survives a reload. A new seller offer was auto-translated into all 7 locales. All in-app ConfirmButton dialogs work, and no native browser dialogs fired: admin order Release / Refund / Cancel (each Cancel button closes the dialog with no change), category create/edit/delete, review delete (cancel tested), payout reject with a note (note saved, balance returned), the buyer's 'I received the item' (cancel, then confirm -> completed), and seller cabinet archive-offer. Review hide/show, seller verification and offer status are applied straight away without a dialog. They worked and saved; since they can be undone, that is acceptable. Money flow: checkout -> real Stripe test redirect -> signed webhook -> delivered. Seller pending was +295; after admin Release, balance went from 148 to 443 and pending to 0. After buyer confirm, balance went +148. Refund of a delivered order -> refunded. Cancel of a pending order -> cancelled. Regression OK: login for admin/seller/buyer, BuyBox (qty, option, PayPal/Razorpay/Crypto disabled with 'NOT SET UP'), seller create/edit offer (price saved as 275), payout request, reviews only on completed orders (the delivered order has no review-form), review posted. Mobile 390: search input is about 138px wide and readable; no horizontal overflow on home in en/ru. One overflow remains on the offer page in ru (details below). The offer grid error state with Retry exists (OfferCard.tsx: q.isError -> offers-error + Retry); checked by code review only.

minor.issue: About 17-19 of 41 offer titles per locale are stored exactly the same as the English title. Some are brand names (fine), but others are plain English phrases: 'Music streaming Premium — Instant', 'Antivirus Total Security 1 year', 'Indie game bundle Steam key', 'Video streaming Standard plan — Instant', 'Limited: Golden Crown of O'Malley — Instant'. Elsewhere the '— Instant' suffix IS translated (ko '즉시', es 'Instantáneo'). Descriptions are translated, but parts stay English, e.g. 'Region: Global. Platform: PC / Mobile.' and 'How to redeem:' on es/ar offer pages.
Code sets SameSite=lax, but the browser receives 'SameSite=None; Partitioned' through the public URL. This is most likely rewritten by the preview proxy, not the app. Info only: verify on production.

ui_bugs.issue: The long 'НЕ НАСТРОЕНО' badge next to 'Криптовалюта' overflows the tile, so the page is 402px wide in a 390px viewport (horizontal scroll). en is fine. Fix: let the badge wrap or truncate (min-w-0, flex-wrap), or put the badge under the label on small screens.

issues: On the first load of /auth (dev server), typing and clicking before hydration is lost: the fields clear and the click does nothing. Fine after about 8s. Production build should be fine; consider disabling the submit button until hydrated.
Sonner toasts at top-right cover the Profile button for a few seconds after an action.
Admin and seller land on '/' after login rather than /admin or /cabinet (test_credentials.md suggests a role landing page). Optional.

action_items: Translate the remaining non-brand offer titles and the English fragments in descriptions (re-run the translation with a prompt that keeps only brand names).
Fix the BuyBox 'Not set up' badge overflow on mobile for long locales (ru).
Delete or rewrite the obsolete /app/backend/tests/test_api_v1.py. It targets the pre-migration /api/v1 REST endpoints on localhost:3000, which now return 404: 7 failures that are not app regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin review hide/show, seller verification select and offer status select change data immediately on click/change without confirmation. Acceptable because they can be undone, but a misclick on offer status 'archived' hides an offer at once.
ConfirmButton's AlertDialogAction closes before the async onConfirm finishes, so there is no busy state and double actions are possible. Minor.
en.json is {} (keys are the English strings). OK by design.

success_rate.backend: 100% (webhook/public tests in test_juj_payments_webhook.py; test_api_v1.py is obsolete)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dev server hydration is slow: after networkidle wait about 8s before typing on /auth, and after the page loads before clicking buy-button. To make a paid order: buyer clicks buy-button -> waits for checkout.stripe.com URL -> run 'cd /app/backend && set -a && . ../frontend/.env && set +a && python -m pytest tests/test_juj_payments_webhook.py -k pending' (it marks the newest pending stripe order as paid/delivered). pytest.ini adds xdist flags, so do not pass -p no:xdist. ConfirmButton testids: <id>, <id>-dialog, <id>-confirm, <id>-cancel, <id>-note.
